metadata.title: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 | Uniglo
metadata.description: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich 2027, 19–22 February. Find event details, tickets and natural-diamond sourcing information.

announcement: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 · 19–22 February · Trade Fair Center Messe München · Meet Uniglo Diamonds

hero.title: Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich 2027
hero.lead: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 will take place from 19–22 February 2027 at the Trade Fair Center Messe München in Munich, Germany.
hero.para1: The international trade exhibition brings together jewellery retailers, diamond buyers, manufacturers, designers, gemstone specialists, watch professionals and industry service providers from markets around the world. Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to return to INHORGENTA Munich 2027 with a carefully selected presentation of natural diamonds for different retail, wholesale, manufacturing and jewellery-design requirements.
hero.para2: Visitors will be able to explore diamond options, compare specifications and discuss individual stones, matched pairs, calibrated diamonds and repeat-supply requirements directly with the Uniglo Diamonds team. The Uniglo Diamonds hall and stand number will be added once officially confirmed.

industry.title: Where the International Jewellery Industry Looks Ahead
industry.para1: February is an important planning period for jewellery businesses. Retailers are reviewing the previous year, adjusting their inventories and identifying the products that will shape bridal, gifting and everyday jewellery sales during the months ahead.
industry.para2: Manufacturers are preparing new production schedules, while designers and jewellery brands are developing collections for future launches. Diamond wholesalers and sourcing teams may also be reviewing suppliers, quality combinations and repeat-availability requirements.
industry.para3: INHORGENTA provides an opportunity to complete this research within one professional environment. Buyers can examine diamonds, gemstones and jewellery closely, compare suppliers, discuss sourcing requirements and gain a clearer understanding of the trends influencing international markets.
industry.para4: The exhibition represents different parts of the jewellery, watch and gemstone value chain across six halls. Its areas cover fine jewellery, watches, gemstones, wedding and design collections, lifestyle jewellery, technology, packaging and other industry services.
industry.para5: INHORGENTA's latest published success figures report 1,334 brands from 38 countries and approximately 25,000 trade visitors from around 100 countries.
industry.imageAlt: INHORGENTA Munich international jewellery trade exhibition

discover.title: Discover Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich 2027
discover.para1: Every diamond buyer has a different audience and commercial requirement. Some retailers need dependable centre stones for bridal jewellery. Others may be looking for distinctive fancy-shaped diamonds, matched stones for earrings or calibrated diamonds for repeatable jewellery collections.
discover.para2: Manufacturers may require tightly controlled measurements across a production run, while bespoke jewellers may need an individual diamond selected around a client's specific request.
discover.para3: At INHORGENTA Munich 2027, Uniglo Diamonds plans to present natural diamonds suited to these different requirements. The final exhibition selection will be confirmed closer to the event, but buyers can prepare to discuss requirements across multiple shapes, carat weights, colours, clarities, measurements and jewellery applications.
discover.para4: The objective is not simply to display a large diamond inventory. It is to understand what the buyer is trying to manufacture, stock or sell and identify diamonds that correspond with those commercial requirements.
discover.imageAlt: Natural-diamond buyer meeting Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA

precision.title: Natural Diamonds Selected With Precision
precision.para1: Every successful diamond jewellery collection begins with an informed choice of stones. At Uniglo Diamonds, natural diamonds are considered across their complete combination of shape, colour, clarity, carat weight, cut quality, measurements, proportions and documentation.
precision.para2: These factors must be evaluated together because two diamonds with the same carat weight can differ noticeably in face-up size, visual appearance and suitability for a particular design.
precision.shapesLabel: The planned selection for INHORGENTA Munich 2027 may include:
precision.shapesNote: The final diamond selection will depend on availability at the time of the exhibition.
precision.discussLabel: Meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team gives buyers an opportunity to discuss:
discussItems: Diamond specifications for different retail price points
Shapes suited to bridal and everyday jewellery
Diamond matching for earrings and multi-stone designs

shapes.title: Diamond Shapes for Different Jewellery Markets
shapes.para1: Diamond-shape preferences differ across markets, customer groups and jewellery categories. Round Brilliant diamonds remain important for engagement rings, solitaire jewellery, earrings, tennis designs and other classic diamond pieces.
shapes.para2: Oval, Pear and Marquise diamonds provide elongated proportions and may create greater visual coverage. Emerald and Asscher-cut diamonds have a more architectural appearance defined by their step-cut faceting and broad flashes of light.
shapes.para3: Cushion and Radiant diamonds combine distinctive outlines with lively brilliance, while Princess-cut diamonds remain relevant for square and geometric designs. Heart-shaped diamonds may suit romantic, gifting or personalised jewellery.
shapes.para4: Rather than treating every diamond shape as equally appropriate for every business, Uniglo Diamonds considers how the stone will be positioned, set and sold. This helps buyers select diamonds that correspond more closely to the preferences of their customers and the structure of their existing inventories.

bridal.title: Diamonds for Bridal and Engagement Jewellery
bridal.para1: Bridal jewellery remains one of the most commercially important applications for polished diamonds. Retailers may require documented centre stones across several popular shapes, carat weights and quality combinations. Manufacturers may need centre diamonds with coordinated side stones for repeatable engagement-ring designs.
bridal.para2: Bespoke jewellers may instead require one individual natural diamond selected around a client's setting, budget and visual preferences.
bridal.discussLabel: At INHORGENTA Munich 2027, buyers can discuss diamonds for:
bridal.para3: A commercially useful bridal inventory often requires a balance between familiar centre-stone options and more distinctive diamonds for customers seeking something individual. Buyers should consider which shapes, sizes, price positions or quality combinations are currently missing from their bridal assortments before attending.

matching.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewellery Production
matching.para1: Matching is particularly important when several diamonds will be used together within the same jewellery design. Diamond earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets, tennis necklaces and other multi-stone pieces require consistency across relevant characteristics.
matching.para2: For jewellery manufacturers, accurate calibration can also support setting efficiency and production repeatability. Diamonds that vary significantly in size or proportion may require adjustments during setting and can create an uneven finished appearance.
matching.para3: These requirements should be explained at the beginning of the sourcing process so the proposed diamond selection reflects the final jewellery application.
matching.imageAlt: Matched and calibrated natural diamonds from Uniglo Diamonds

measurements.title: Understanding Measurements and Proportions
measurements.para1: Carat weight is an essential diamond measurement, but it does not provide a complete picture of how a polished diamond will appear. Two diamonds with the same carat weight may have different dimensions, proportions and face-up appearances. This is especially relevant for fancy-shaped diamonds, where outline and length-to-width ratio can significantly affect the character of the stone.
measurements.para2: A manufacturer may require precise dimensions to fit an existing mounting. A retailer may prefer an Oval or Emerald diamond with a specific length-to-width ratio. A designer may need stones with proportions that support a particular creative direction.
measurements.considerLabel: Before meeting Uniglo Diamonds, buyers should consider whether they require:
considerItems: Existing mountings that must be accommodated
Visual qualities not fully described by a grading report

certification.title: Diamond Certification and Documentation
certification.para1: Certification and documentation requirements can vary depending on a diamond's size, value, intended market and customer expectations. Some buyers require individual grading reports for centre stones. Other applications may use commercial documentation appropriate to smaller or calibrated diamonds.
certification.considerLabel: Before meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team, buyers should identify:
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Whether documents must accompany each stone
Requirements for matched pairs or calibrated layouts
certification.para2: Documentation should be discussed at the beginning of the sourcing process rather than after a selection has already been prepared.

meetingPlace.title: A Meeting Place for Sourcing, Knowledge and Innovation
meetingPlace.para1: INHORGENTA is more than an exhibition of finished products. Its different halls and supporting programmes help professionals understand how the wider industry is changing. Visitors can examine fine and high jewellery, watches, diamonds, gemstones, contemporary design, bridal collections, packaging and technology.
meetingPlace.para2: For buyers, this combination helps place individual sourcing decisions within a wider commercial context. A diamond may be attractive on its own, but retailers must also consider how it fits current customer preferences, existing inventory, target price ranges and future jewellery collections.
meetingPlace.para3: For Uniglo Diamonds, participating in this environment provides an opportunity to listen as well as present. Conversations with retailers, wholesalers, designers and manufacturers help the team understand how diamond preferences are developing across European and international markets.

whyMeet.title: Why Meet Uniglo Diamonds at the Exhibition?
whyMeet.para1: Digital inventories and virtual meetings make initial diamond sourcing more efficient, but diamonds often benefit from an in-person assessment. Viewing a diamond directly can reveal aspects of its outline, proportions, face-up size and overall visual character that may not be completely communicated through a grading report or standard photograph.
whyMeet.benefitsLabel: A meeting with Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich 2027 can help visitors:
benefits: Compare different shapes and quality combinations
Discuss target customers and price positions
Plan bridal or core diamond inventories
Build a direct relationship with the Uniglo Diamonds team
whyMeet.note: Buyers with specific requirements should prepare their preferred shapes, carat ranges, measurements, colours, clarities, quantities and approximate target prices before the meeting.
whyMeet.imageAlt: Diamond-sourcing meeting with Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich

antwerp.title: Antwerp-Based Diamond Sourcing Expertise
antwerp.para1: Antwerp has played an important role in the international diamond trade for generations. Uniglo Diamonds' Antwerp background connects the business with one of the world's most established diamond-trading centres.
antwerp.para2: However, location alone does not create a successful sourcing relationship. Buyers also require clear communication, correctly understood specifications, realistic delivery expectations and consistent follow-up. A diamond supplier must understand not only which grades have been requested but also how the diamonds will be used and sold.
antwerp.para3: Uniglo Diamonds approaches sourcing by first understanding the buyer's intended product, market and customer. This allows the team to assess which shapes, measurements, quality combinations and supply arrangements may be most appropriate.
antwerp.para4: This approach can support a retailer sourcing individual centre stones, a manufacturer preparing a repeat collection, a wholesaler serving several markets or a designer developing a specialised diamond-led range.

partnerships.title: Partnerships That Continue Beyond Munich
partnerships.para1: The most valuable exhibition conversations are not always those that lead to an immediate order. Some begin with a specific diamond requirement, while others start with a wider discussion about a future collection, an inventory gap or a market opportunity.
partnerships.para2: INHORGENTA gives Uniglo Diamonds an opportunity to reconnect with established partners while meeting buyers discovering the company for the first time.
partnerships.nextStepsLabel: After the exhibition, buyers may wish to:
nextSteps: Request a more focused diamond selection
Schedule another viewing or sourcing conversation
partnerships.para3: Long-term diamond-sourcing relationships depend on more than the initial presentation. They are built through transparent communication, consistent quality, dependable service and an understanding of the buyer's commercial objectives.

planning.title: Planning Your Visit
planning.para1: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 is exclusively intended for approved trade visitors. New visitors may need to provide evidence of their professional involvement, qualifications or relevant study before purchasing a ticket.
planning.para2: The 2027 ticket shop is scheduled to open on 5 December 2026. Visitors may also be able to register at the venue, but the organiser advises that advance registration can save time and may cost less than purchasing admission on site.

planning.note: INHORGENTA tickets do not include local public transport, so visitors should plan their journey to Messe München separately.

lookingAhead.title: Looking Ahead to INHORGENTA Munich 2027
lookingAhead.para1: From 19–22 February 2027, INHORGENTA will bring the international jewellery, watch, diamond and gemstone community together at Messe München.
lookingAhead.para2: Uniglo Diamonds looks forward to presenting a selected natural-diamond portfolio while meeting retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, designers and other industry professionals.
lookingAhead.para3: Whether you are searching for an individually documented centre stone, matched natural diamonds, calibrated stones for jewellery production or a dependable long-term sourcing relationship, we invite you to meet the Uniglo Diamonds team in Munich.
lookingAhead.note: The confirmed Uniglo Diamonds hall and stand number will be published on this page as soon as it becomes available.

items.question: When is INHORGENTA Munich 2027?
items.answer: INHORGENTA Munich 2027 will take place from Friday, 19 February to Monday, 22 February 2027.

items.question: Where is INHORGENTA Munich 2027 being held?
items.answer: The exhibition will take place at the Trade Fair Center Messe München, Am Messesee 2, 81829 Munich, Germany.

items.question: What are the opening hours?
items.answer: Visitor opening hours are 09:30–18:30 from Friday, 19 February through Sunday, 21 February. The exhibition will be open from 09:30–17:00 on Monday, 22 February.

items.question: Who can attend INHORGENTA?
items.answer: INHORGENTA is exclusively intended for approved professionals from the jewellery, watch, gemstone, pearl, design and related technology industries. Trade credentials, professional qualifications or relevant student documentation may be required.

items.question: When can visitors purchase tickets?
items.answer: The INHORGENTA 2027 ticket shop is scheduled to open on 5 December 2026. Ticket prices will be published closer to the opening of the ticket shop.

items.question: Can tickets be purchased at the venue?
items.answer: The organiser states that tickets may be purchased at the exhibition. However, on-site tickets can cost more, and visitors may experience longer waiting times. First-time visitors should bring suitable trade accreditation.

items.question: Does an INHORGENTA ticket include public transport?
items.answer: No. The admission ticket does not include travel on Munich's local public transport system.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' stand number at INHORGENTA Munich 2027?
items.answer: The Uniglo Diamonds hall and stand number have not yet been publicly confirmed. The information will be added to this page when available.

items.question: What will Uniglo Diamonds present at INHORGENTA Munich 2027?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds plans to present natural diamonds across different shapes, carat weights, measurements, colours and clarities. The final exhibition selection will be confirmed closer to the event.

items.question: Which diamond shapes can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss Round Brilliant, Oval, Emerald, Pear, Cushion, Princess, Radiant, Marquise, Heart and Asscher diamonds, subject to availability and their required specifications.

items.question: Can buyers discuss matched or calibrated diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss matched pairs, calibrated diamond selections, coordinated side stones and layouts for multi-stone jewellery.

items.question: Can manufacturers discuss repeat-supply requirements?
items.answer: Yes. Manufacturers should provide their required shapes, measurements, quality ranges, quantities and production schedules when discussing repeat supply.

items.question: Can buyers discuss certified natural diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers should provide their certification and grading-report requirements when arranging their meeting.

items.question: Should buyers arrange a meeting with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Arranging a meeting is recommended for buyers with detailed diamond requirements. Meeting-booking information will be added once Uniglo Diamonds' stand and appointment arrangements are confirmed.

finalCta.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Munich
finalCta.para: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at INHORGENTA Munich 2027 to explore natural diamonds and Antwerp-based sourcing possibilities created around the requirements of your business. Prepare your preferred shapes, measurements, quality ranges, documentation requirements and intended jewellery applications so the team can plan a more relevant discussion.
